14.t: Working with data: heart rate and fitness
q: State Student B’s heart rate straight after exercise.
Calculate how much A’s heart rate fell in the first 2 minutes.
Which student is fitter? Give two pieces of evidence.
Student A: lower heart rate after exercise and much faster recovery (back to about 66 in 4 minutes; B still 84 after 6).
Explain why a fitter heart can beat more slowly at rest.
Its muscle is stronger, so it pumps more blood per beat: it needs fewer beats per minute to deliver the same oxygen.
